pearls.purpose: The install-admin companion grain for the Cyberteller constellation. Hosts the single ConfigGate Grapple capability every cyberteller grain claims at first launch — hands back the 6 boot env vars (AITX_URL, FINREACT_SIDECAR_URL, FINREACT_TRUST_BUNDLE, FINREACT_CREDIT_PRIVKEY, FINREACT_TEMP_SUSPENSE_GLID, FINREACT_COLD_WALLET_GLID). Admin browser session edits values via HTML form gated on the Sandstorm `admin` permission bit; peer cyberteller grains receive a non-admin Consumer role at share time so they can call getEnv but not setEnv. No external sidecar dependencies.

offers.name: config-gate
offers.purpose: Single Grapple cap claimed by every cyberteller grain in the install. Methods: hello(grainId) -> Greeting (install label + config digest for drift detection), getEnv() -> EnvConfig (read-only, returns the 6 boot env strings + updatedAtMs), setEnv(env) -> digest (admin-bit-gated mutation).
